question: How does KXTXR know what it claims to know?
answer: By reconstructing each claim from a versioned source reference through explicit epistemic transformations. KXTXR does not treat a model output, publication, metric or narrative as truth merely because it exists.

current_known: Eight new masters have reproducible relational audio measurements.
The album field is not sonically homogeneous; each track has a distinct functional position.
REM3002 ACUSTICO is the strongest spectral counterweight in the new-master set.
ESPINAS and LUGAR LUNAR provide the largest macro-dynamic relief among the new masters.
AELUDE, BLVCK and ODIO DECIRTELO occupy related low/bass-heavy territory.
The ensemble leaves increasing negative spectral space above 4 kHz, especially above 10 kHz.
QUE NO, 111 and REM618 are reference objects in this analysis, not new HIVE masters.
KYRIE | PHOSPHOROS is not observed in the supplied WAV set.
At the time of the Ruche analysis, empirical campaign RETURN remained missing.
